bookmarksIo.commandSkipped: (skipped: a bookmark with this name exists, so this command is not imported)
bookmarksIo.exportIntro: Save your bookmarks to a file to back them up or move them to another computer.
bookmarksIo.exportSkippedIntro: Some fields could not be written and were left out:
bookmarksIo.fileConflicts_one: {{count}} bookmark in the file has the same name as an existing one.
bookmarksIo.fileConflicts_other: {{count}} bookmarks in the file have the same name as existing ones.

formatHint.json: Keeps everything: groups, tags, colors, start folders and speed limits. Can be imported again.
formatHint.sshConfig: A file in OpenSSH config format for other tools. Groups, tags, colors, start folders and speed limits cannot be stored in it.

bookmarksIo.importStale: This import is no longer valid. Open the file again.
bookmarksIo.keepStartup: Keep startup commands from this file
bookmarksIo.keepStartupHint: Off by default: startup commands are removed, because they run in your shell when you connect.
bookmarksIo.keepStartupWarning: These commands will run in your shell on the server every time you connect. Only keep them if you trust this file.
bookmarksIo.noPasswords: Passwords are never imported. Bookmarks that use a password need it entered again.
bookmarksIo.passwordsNeverExported: Passwords are never exported. Saved passwords stay in the system keychain.
bookmarksIo.startupStripped_one: The startup command of {{count}} bookmark was not imported:
bookmarksIo.startupStripped_other: The startup commands of {{count}} bookmarks were not imported:
bookmarksIo.startupStrippedHint: A file can contain commands that run in your terminal, so they are not imported unless you choose to keep them. Add the command again in the bookmark if you trust it.
bookmarksIo.strategy: If a bookmark with the same name exists

strategyHint.duplicate: The imported bookmark is added with a number after its name, for example “prod (2)”.
strategyHint.replace: The existing bookmark is overwritten with the imported one. A saved password is forgotten if the host, port or user changed.
strategyHint.skip: The existing bookmark is kept and the imported one is ignored.

closeBuffer.body: {{name}} has unsaved changes. If you close it without saving, they are lost.
closeBuffer.offline: The connection is down, so nothing can be saved right now.
closeBuffer.title: Save changes to {{name}}?

closeSession.body_one: {{files}} has unsaved changes that will be lost if you close this connection.
closeSession.body_other: {{count}} files have unsaved changes: {{files}}. They will be lost if you close this connection.
closeSession.title: Unsaved changes

closeTerminals.body_one: A terminal is still running a shell. Closing it ends the shell and any program running in it.
closeTerminals.body_other: {{count}} terminals are still running a shell. Closing them ends the shells and any programs running in them.
closeTerminals.hint: You can turn this question off in Settings, General.

configWarnings.fileTooLarge: {{file}} is too large and was ignored.
configWarnings.includeDepthExceeded: Include nesting is too deep at {{pattern}}.
configWarnings.includeRecursiveGlob: The Include pattern {{pattern}} uses ** which is not supported.
configWarnings.includeTooManyFiles: The Include pattern {{pattern}} matches too many files.
configWarnings.invalidHostname: {{value}} is not a valid host name.
configWarnings.proxyCommandUnsupported: {{alias}} uses ProxyCommand, which is not supported. Use ProxyJump instead.
configWarnings.untrustedFile: {{file}} has unsafe ownership or permissions and was ignored.

configWarningsDialog.fileSkipped: The file was skipped: it is not a config file (key material or binary data).

conflict.body: This file changed on the server after you opened it (from a terminal, a script or another user). Saving now would replace the server's version.
conflict.compareFailed: Could not compare with the server version: {{reason}}
conflict.goneBody: The file no longer exists on the server. Your version is still open here.
conflict.goneHint: Save again creates the file anew with your text. Close the tab to let it go.
conflict.hint: Overwrite replaces the server's version with yours. Reload from server discards your changes.
conflict.sameText: The text is identical; only the file's modification time changed.
conflict.symlink: This path is a symbolic link. Saving writes to the file it points to, which may be somewhere else on the server.
conflict.symlinkTarget: This path is a symbolic link. Overwrite writes to this file instead:
conflict.title: {{name}} changed on the server
conflict.tooLongToCompare: The texts are too long to compare line by line.

connect.authAutoHelp: Tries ssh-agent, then your default keys (~/.ssh/id_*), then asks for a password.
connect.confirmConnectHint: Ask every time you connect to this bookmark. Automatic reconnects do not ask.

errors.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number up to 1 GiB/s.
errors.notesInvalid: Notes can have at most 4000 characters and no control characters.
errors.portInvalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
errors.startupCommandInvalid: Use a single line of at most 1024 characters, without tabs or other control characters.

connect.hostHint: You can paste user@host:port here and it will be split into the fields.
connect.name: Name (optional)
connect.nameHint: Shown in the bookmark list and on the tab.
connect.notesHint: Plain text, up to {{max}} characters. Only you see it.
connect.passphraseHint: If the key is protected by a passphrase, you will be asked for it when connecting.
connect.passwordWillBeForgotten: Changing the host, port, user or jump host removes the saved password.
connect.savePassword: Save in system keychain (Keychain / Credential Manager / Secret Service)
connect.savePasswordOff: Saving passwords is turned off in Settings, Connection. The password is used for this connection only.
connect.startupCommandHint: One line, sent to the first terminal after connecting, as if you typed it and pressed Enter. Leave empty for none.
connect.testNeedsAnswer: The server is waiting for your answer.

connectConfirm.body: This bookmark asks for confirmation before it connects.
connectConfirm.title: Connect to {{name}}?

disconnectKind.jumpHostLost: The connection to a jump host was lost.

editor.binary: {{name}} looks like a binary file, so it can't be edited here. You can download it instead.
editor.empty: Open a file from the tree to start editing.
editor.notText: {{name}} is not valid {{encoding}} text. Try another encoding.
editor.offlineDirty: Offline: changes are saved after reconnecting
editor.readOnlyBanner: You probably can't save this file: its permissions don't allow your user to write it. You can still try.
editor.tooLarge: {{name}} is {{size}}, which is over the editing limit of {{limit}}. You can download it instead.
editor.unsupportedEncoding: The encoding {{encoding}} is not supported, so {{name}} can't be opened with it.

encoding.hint: Reopen reads the file again and decodes it with the chosen encoding. Save keeps your text and encodes it this way the next time you save.
encoding.label: Encoding
encoding.title: Encoding of {{name}}

errorReport.clipboardHint: “Report on GitHub…” copies this full report to the clipboard and opens a pre-filled bug form in your browser. Paste the report into the form if anything is missing. Nothing is sent until you submit the form yourself.
errorReport.copyFailed: The report could not be copied to the clipboard. Use “Copy details” and paste it into the form.
errorReport.frontendMessage: Something went wrong in the Shellfin window. This is a bug; please report it.
errorReport.includeLog: Include the last lines of the log
errorReport.includeLogHint: Off by default. Host names, IP addresses, user names and paths are replaced with placeholders; check the preview.
errorReport.logEmpty: The current log has no lines to include.
errorReport.logPartial_one: Only the newest log line (of {{total}}) fits into the form. The full report is on the clipboard.
errorReport.logPartial_other: Only the newest {{count}} of {{total}} log lines fit into the form. The full report is on the clipboard.
errorReport.more_one: {{count}} more unexpected error happened since this dialog opened.
errorReport.more_other: {{count}} more unexpected errors happened since this dialog opened.
errorReport.noErrorIntro: This report contains your Shellfin version and basic system information. Add the last lines of the log if they help to explain the problem.
errorReport.openBody: This opens a pre-filled bug report form on GitHub. Nothing is submitted until you submit the form there.
errorReport.openTitle: Open the bug report form in your browser?
errorReport.previewFailed: The report could not be prepared.
errorReport.reported: The full report is on the clipboard. Paste it into the form if you want to include more than what was filled in.
errorReport.title: Error details

errors.agentConstraintUnsupported: This ssh-agent doesn't support temporary keys, so the key was not added. It is still used for this session.
errors.agentNoIdentities: The ssh-agent has no keys loaded.
errors.agentUntrusted: The ssh-agent was ignored because it is not owned by you.
errors.bug: Something went wrong inside Shellfin ({{command}}). This is a bug; please report it.
errors.channelOpenFailed: The server refused to open a channel.
errors.connectTimeout: Connecting to {{host}}:{{port}} timed out after {{seconds}} s.
errors.dropExpired: The dropped files are no longer available. Drop them again.
errors.encodingUnmappable: Some characters cannot be saved in {{encoding}}.
errors.hostKeyCaManaged: {{host}}:{{port}} uses a certificate authority, which is not supported. The connection was refused.
errors.hostKeyChanged: The host key of {{host}}:{{port}} has changed. This could be an attack. The connection was refused.
errors.hostKeyMismatchOnReconnect: The host key of {{host}}:{{port}} changed since you connected. The connection was refused.
errors.hostKeyRejected: You declined the host key of {{host}}:{{port}}.
errors.hostKeyRevoked: The host key of {{host}}:{{port}} is revoked. The connection was refused.
errors.hostKeyUnknownStrict: {{host}}:{{port}} is not in known_hosts and strict host key checking is on.
errors.invalidHostname: {{value}} is not a valid host name.
errors.invalidHostSpec: {{spec}} is not a valid host specification.
errors.kexFailed: Key exchange with the server failed.
errors.keyringError: The system keychain reported an error.
errors.keyringUnavailable: The system keychain is not available.
errors.knownHostsIgnored: {{file}} was ignored (unsafe ownership or permissions, or too large). Hosts recorded only there are treated as unknown, and new host keys are confirmed by you.
errors.notARegularFile: {{path}} is not a regular file (a pipe, socket or device) and cannot be opened or downloaded.
errors.promptNotFound: This prompt is no longer active.
errors.proxyCommandUnsupported: {{alias}} uses ProxyCommand, which is not supported. Use ProxyJump instead.
errors.proxyJumpCycle: The jump host chain loops back on itself.
errors.secretStorageDisabled: Saving passwords is turned off in Settings.
errors.sftpFailure: The SFTP server reported an error.
errors.sftpUnavailable: SFTP is not available on this server.
errors.storageCorrupt: {{file}} was damaged and has been moved aside.
errors.tooManyAuthFailures: The server stopped accepting login attempts.
errors.updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.updateDownloadFailed: The update could not be downloaded. Try again later.
errors.updateInProgress: An update is already being downloaded or installed.
errors.updateInstallFailed: The update could not be installed. The current version keeps running.
errors.updateManualOnly: This installation cannot update itself. Download the new version from the release page.
errors.updateNotFound: This update is no longer offered. Check for updates again.
errors.updatesDisabled: Updates are not available in this build.
errors.updateVerifyFailed: The downloaded update failed the signature check, so it was not installed.

files.deleteFileBody: The file is deleted on the server. This can't be undone.
files.deleteFolderBody: The folder must be empty. This can't be undone.
files.deleteMayFail: This will probably fail: your user probably can't change items in this folder. You can still try, the server decides.
files.empty: Connect to a host to browse its files.
files.folderNotWritable: You probably can't create items in this folder: its permissions don't allow your user to write there. You can still try.
files.goToFolderHint: An absolute path on the server, or ~ for the home folder
files.lossyName: This name contains characters that could not be decoded, so it can't be opened or changed.
files.moveHint: An absolute path on the server, for example /srv/app/logs
files.moveMayFail: This will probably fail: your user probably can't change items in the current folder.

nameProblem.nul: A name can't contain a NUL character.
nameProblem.slash: A name can't contain a slash.

files.offline: Connection lost. Showing the last known listing.
files.parentNotWritable: You probably can't change items in this folder: its permissions don't allow your user to write there. You can still try.
files.probablyNoAccess: You probably can't open this folder: its permissions don't allow your user to list it.
files.probablyReadOnly: You probably can't change this file: its permissions don't allow your user to write it.
files.sftpUnavailable: SFTP is not available on this server.
files.title: Files
files.truncatedCount_one: The list is incomplete: only the first entry is shown.
files.truncatedCount_other: The list is incomplete: only the first {{count}} entries are shown.

fix.agentNoIdentities: Run ssh-add to load a key into the agent, or choose a key file in Edit connection.
fix.agentUnavailable: Start your ssh-agent, or choose a key file in Edit connection.
fix.authFailed: Check the user name and the key or password. In Edit connection you can choose a specific key.
fix.connectRefused: Is sshd running on port {{port}}? Check the port and the firewall.
fix.connectTimeout: Check the network or firewall. A jump host may be required to reach this server.
fix.dnsFailed: Check the host name, or your VPN and DNS settings.
fix.hostKeyRejected: Connect again and accept the host key if you trust this server.
fix.jumpChannelFailed: Check that the jump host can reach the target host and port.
fix.kexFailed: The server and this app share no encryption settings. The server may be very old or restricted.
fix.keyProblem: Check the key file and its passphrase in Edit connection.
fix.networkUnreachable: Check that you are online and connected to the right network or VPN.
fix.tooManyAuthFailures: Too many keys were offered. Pick a specific key in Edit connection.

help.openTitle: Open this page in your browser?

hostKey.body: This host is not in {{file}} yet. Compare the fingerprint with the one shown on the server ({{command}}).
hostKey.cannotRemember: known_hosts cannot be updated, so this key is trusted for this session only.
hostKey.mismatchInstruction: The server now offers a different key than the one this tab was opened with. Check the new fingerprint with the server's administrator before you open a new tab.
hostKey.otherTypesKnown: known_hosts already has other key types for this host ({{types}}). Make sure this is the same server.
hostKey.removeInstruction: After you have verified the server's new key, remove the old entry from that file and connect again.

hosts.deleteBody: Delete the bookmark {{name}}? A password saved for it is removed from the system keychain too.

group.deleteBody_one: The group {{name}} has {{count}} bookmark. Bookmarks are never deleted with a group: choose where this one goes.
group.deleteBody_other: The group {{name}} has {{count}} bookmarks. Bookmarks are never deleted with a group: choose where they go.

hosts.orQuickConnect: Or type user@host in the Quick connect box.
hosts.readOnlyHint: Bookmarks are read-only right now (the data file cannot be written). You can still connect, but changes are not saved.
hosts.sshConfigHint: Hosts from {{file}} are loaded automatically, including Include files. Edit them in the file, or copy them to your bookmarks.
hosts.title: Bookmarks

info.dropNoTarget: Drop files onto the file tree to upload them.
info.foldersUnsupported: Folders are not supported yet. Drop files instead.
info.mixedEol: {{name}} has mixed line endings. Saving makes them all the same; the status bar shows which.
info.outputTooLarge: The terminal output is too large to save.
info.shortcutSwallowed: {{combo}} went to the shell because the terminal has the focus. Press F6 (or click outside the terminal) first, or use Ctrl+Shift+K for the command palette from inside the terminal.
info.updateAvailable: Shellfin {{version}} is available. Choose Help → Check for updates… to install it.

palette.pathNeedsSession: Connect to a server first to go to a path.
palette.placeholder: Hosts, files and commands. Type > for commands, @ for hosts or / for a path.
palette.title: Command palette

errors.passphraseIncorrect_one: Incorrect passphrase. Try again ({{count}} attempt left).
errors.passphraseIncorrect_other: Incorrect passphrase. Try again ({{count}} attempts left).
errors.passwordIncorrect_one: Incorrect password. Try again ({{count}} attempt left).
errors.passwordIncorrect_other: Incorrect password. Try again ({{count}} attempts left).

passphrase.addToAgent: Add key to ssh-agent for this session

quit.body_one: {{files}} has unsaved changes that will be lost if you quit.
quit.body_other: {{count}} files have unsaved changes: {{files}}. They will be lost if you quit.
quit.connections_one: {{count}} connection is open. Quitting closes it.
quit.connections_other: {{count}} connections are open. Quitting closes them.
quit.terminals_one: A terminal is still running a shell. Quitting ends it.
quit.terminals_other: {{count}} terminals are still running a shell. Quitting ends them.
quit.title: Unsaved changes

reconnect.title: Connection to {{host}} lost
reconnect.unsavedNote: Unsaved changes in {{files}} stay in the editor. Pending saves run after reconnecting.

session.reconnectToApplyHint: The bookmark was changed. Bandwidth limits already apply; the host, user, port, jump host and login method need a new connection.

settings.altIsMetaInfo: Option sends Escape-prefixed keys for shell and Emacs shortcuts instead of typing special characters.

appearance.accentInfo: Used for focus rings, selection marks and primary buttons. The logo stays teal.
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.uiFontSizeInfo: Scales menus, lists, dialogs and the file tree. Terminal and editor text have their own sizes.

settings.autoRefreshInfo: Reloads the folders open in the file tree. Paused while the window is hidden or the connection is down.
settings.autoUpdateInfo: Checks shortly after startup and then once a day. Nothing is downloaded until you choose to update.
settings.bandwidthInfo: Applies to file uploads and downloads, not to the editor or terminal.
settings.bandwidthInvalid: Enter a whole number up to 1 GiB/s (0 for no limit).
settings.clearRecentsBody: The list of recent connections on the start screen and in the palette is emptied. Bookmarks, known hosts and keys are not touched.
settings.confirmCloseWithTerminalsInfo: Asks before closing a connection or terminal tab while a shell is running. Quitting the app has its own setting.
settings.confirmQuitInfo: When the app asks before it closes. Unsaved editor changes are always asked about.
settings.defaultUserInfo: Prefilled in quick connect and new bookmarks. Leave empty for none.
settings.detectIndentationInfo: Uses the file's own tabs or spaces when they are clear; otherwise the settings above.
settings.fontCustomHint: An installed monospace font, or a comma-separated list.

fontError.badChars: Use font names with letters, digits, spaces and - _ ' " , only.

settings.fontLigaturesInfo: Draws character pairs such as => and != as one symbol, if the font has them. The terminal always shows plain characters.
settings.hideMousePointer: Hide the mouse pointer while typing
settings.insertFinalNewline: Insert a final newline on save
settings.logLevelInfo: Debug adds technical details to the log file, which helps when reporting a problem. Passwords, terminal output and file contents are never logged.
settings.maxFileSizeWarning: Opening files larger than {{limit}} MiB can make the editor slow and use a lot of memory.
settings.minimumContrastInfo: {{min}} is off, 4.5 meets WCAG AA. Text colors are adjusted when they would be hard to read.
settings.mouseReportingInfo: When off, programs such as tmux or vim cannot capture the mouse, so it always selects text. When on, hold Shift while dragging to select.
settings.multilinePasteWarningInfo: Asks first when pasted text has line breaks and the program does not use bracketed paste, because the shell would run every line at once.
settings.newFileEolInfo: Only for files created in Shellfin. Existing files keep their own line endings.
settings.newTerminalCwdCurrent: The folder open in the file tree
settings.newTerminalCwdInfo: If that folder cannot be used (not a POSIX server, gone, no access), the home folder is used instead.
settings.onConflictInfo: What an upload does when a file with the same name is on the server. Applies to transfers started afterwards.
settings.onExitCloseOnSuccess: Close it if the shell ended normally
settings.onSaveInfo: Applied when the file is saved. You can undo it in the editor.
settings.onStartupInfo: Reopening restores the bookmarked connections that were open when you quit. Credentials are asked for as usual.
settings.openTerminalOnConnectInfo: When off, a connection opens with the file tree only. Open a terminal from the panel when you need one.
settings.preserveTimestampsInfo: Uploads set the time of the remote file, downloads the time of the local file.
settings.readSshConfigInfo: When off, the hosts from your SSH config are hidden and the file is not read.
settings.rememberPasswordsInfo: When off, Shellfin never offers to store a password in the system keychain. Passwords saved earlier keep working.
settings.resetBody: All settings go back to their defaults, including fonts, limits and timeouts. Your saved layout (sidebar, panel sizes, status bar) is reset too. Bookmarks and keys are not touched.
settings.rightClickInfo: Pasting goes through the usual safety check for multi-line text.
settings.screenReaderModeInfo: Mirrors the terminal output into a text area that screen readers can read, and announces new output. Turn it on only if you use a screen reader: it makes the terminal slower.
settings.scrollbackMemory: A full scrollback can use about {{size}} of memory per terminal (at 200 columns).
settings.showPermissionsInfo: Adds permissions, owner and group to each file row (numeric ids when the server gives no names).
settings.sizeUnitsInfo: Binary counts in steps of 1024, decimal in steps of 1000.
settings.terminalBackgroundInfo: Text, cursor and the 16 ANSI colors switch between a dark and a light palette to stay readable.
settings.terminalBackgroundInvalid: Use exactly #RRGGBB: a hash and six hex digits.
settings.termTypeInfo: Sent to the server when a terminal opens. Change it only if a server does not support xterm-256color.
settings.title: Settings
settings.wordSeparatorsInfo: Characters that end a word on double-click. Up to {{max}} printable ASCII characters.
settings.wordSeparatorsInvalid: Use at most {{max}} printable ASCII characters.

shortcuts.intro: Shortcuts that the terminal needs (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+W, …) go to the shell while the terminal has the focus.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts

status.encodingAction: Reopen or save with another encoding
status.eolAction: Switch line endings between LF and CRLF
status.eolMixed: This file had mixed line endings; saving makes them all the same. Click to switch.

terminal.empty: No terminal is open in this session.
terminal.endedHint: This terminal has ended. Click it and press Enter to restart. Double-click to rename.
terminal.exited: [Process exited with code {{code}}] Press Enter to restart
terminal.exitedSignal: [Process terminated by signal {{signal}}] Press Enter to restart
terminal.outputDropped: … {{size}} of output discarded — run `reset` if the display looks wrong …
terminal.pasteBody: This text contains line breaks. The shell may run each line as soon as it is pasted.
terminal.renameHint: Double-click or press F2 to rename
terminal.title: Terminals

transfers.replaceBody_one: {{count}} file already exists in the destination folder. Replace it?
transfers.replaceBody_other: {{count}} files already exist in the destination folder. Choose which ones to replace.
transfers.replaceSymlink: Some of these names are symbolic links. Replacing writes to the files they point to.
transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.waitingDecision: Already exists. Waiting for your decision.

update.manual: This installation cannot update itself. Download the new version from the release page.
update.manualLinux: Shellfin was installed from a .deb or .rpm package, which cannot update itself. Download the new version from the release page, or use the AppImage to get updates automatically.

update.restarting: The update is verified. Shellfin closes, installs it and starts again.

welcome.agentHintUnix: Run ssh-add to load your key into the agent.
welcome.agentHintWindows: Start the OpenSSH Authentication Agent service to use your keys without typing passphrases.
welcome.configMissing: There is no ssh config file yet. Hosts you add to it appear here automatically.
welcome.firstRun: No connections yet. Type user@host in Quick connect and press Enter, or add a server you use often as a bookmark.
welcome.recentEmpty: Your recent connections will appear here.
